item.title: "no coach parking" sign required, 4th August
item.description:
To reduce dangers from coaches driving on parts of Farquhar Road then we need a "no coach parking" sign. Coaches already park regularly on Dulwich Wood Avenue as their drivers have a local base near to this green. There is no safe way a coach can drive into Farquhar Road between Jasper Road, Crystal Palace Parade and the Dulwich Wood Avenue junctions as the corner turns are too sharp. The coach seen today parked can only access by oversailing the curb or reversing into its space.
